# Marisol Ortiz — Front-End Associate (Keyholder)

- **Relationship:** hourly front-end associate; reports to [Tanya Brooks](../people/tanya-brooks.md), so a
  skip-down for Marc. One of the store's most reliable keyholders.
- **Role:** lead cashier and front-end trainer for new hires; opens registers and handles the busiest
  Saturday shifts.
- **Development:** Marc sees real potential — she's a candidate for a department-lead track and is a natural
  at Summit Rewards sign-ups. Tanya is grooming her.
- **⚠️ Scheduling constraint (important):** **Do not schedule Marisol on Fridays.** She is a single parent
  with **no childcare coverage on Fridays**; this was agreed when she was hired and is non-negotiable.
  Building the schedule around any other day is fine.
- **Notes:** picks up extra Saturday/Sunday hours gladly; prefers early shifts.
